3	import requests
4	import structlog
5	
6	log = structlog.get_logger()
7	
8	LEDGER_URL = "https://ledger.internal.acme.example/v1/postings"
9	
10	
11	@dataclass
12	class Invoice:
13	    id: str
14	    customer_id: str
15	    subtotal_cents: int
16	    tax_cents: int = 0
